description_en: Queries the authorization progress based on the unique ID (CheckProgressId) returned by the batch device authorization operation
description_zh: 调用该接口根据批量授权设备接口返回的唯一ID（CheckProgressId）查询授权的进度
kebab_example: aliyun iot check-bind-license-device-progress --iot-instance-id iot-2ws0000 --license-code 720P --product-key uhf50000 --check-progress-id 230000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckBindLicenseDeviceProgress

parameters.description_en:
Enterprise instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- For new public instances or Enterprise Edition instances, Enterprise instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- For legacy public instances, Enterprise instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 对于新版公共实例或企业版实例，实例有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
